إِمِدَّانٌ (of the measure إِفْعِلَانٌ, [originally إِمْدِدَانٌ,] S, L) and ↓ مِدَّانٌ (L, K) Salt water: (L, K:) or very salt water: (S, L:) or the water of salt earth. (L.) ―
-b2- Also, the former, Water exuding from the earth: (L, K:) sometimes written, (K,) or as some say, (L,) إِمِّدَانٌ (L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
